prompt:
Classify the customer message (English, Swedish or German). Output exactly one label below as written, with no other text, quotes or punctuation.

Use the label of the first issue mentioned, including when it is the only issue. Before applying that default, check these exact pairwise exceptions, which work in either order:
- billing over technical or bug_report if a payment, charge or invoice is mentioned.
- cancellation over billing or returns if the customer wants to end a subscription.
- privacy over account_access or cancellation if the customer asks about or wants deletion of their personal data.

billing — charges, payments, invoices, receipts, prices, payment methods, charge refunds
technical — setup, connection, configuration or usage help for the product, app or site; nothing reported broken
account_access — login, passwords, two-factor codes, locked or blocked accounts
shipping — order delivery, tracking, delays, delivery address, missing parcels
returns — physical product returns, return labels, exchanges, return window
cancellation — ending a subscription or plan, stopping auto-renewal
feature_request — request for functionality not available
bug_report — product, app or site malfunction: crash, error code, freeze or feature stops working
privacy — personal data storage, copies, deletion, sharing or GDPR requests
partnership — business proposals: reselling, co-marketing, integrations, sponsorship, volume deals
feedback — opinion, praise or complaint without a request for help or action
other — unrelated to the company's products and services
